methodology: 72 new internally authored prose documents and labels frozen before the first run at baseline 561746a. Covers DevOps duties, shared/unresolved ownership, passive/multiword dependencies, rationale variants and uncertain/historical/negated input. Labels are by the implementing coding agent and are not independent human ground truth. Preserve this first result; fixes turn these cases into regression data. Exact document candidate identity and field matches are scored.
